_README: LFS mod-car dimensions database keyed by the 6-hex SkinID
(same canonical form used by Detect&Monitor's cars/mod_sizes.car
and by the URLs at lfs.net/files/vehmods/<6HEX>).
Each entry has: length_m, width_m and an optional source tag.
Seeded from D&M v1.x mod_sizes.car (values converted from cm).
